controlHelp.alphaThreshold: Pixels at or below this alpha value are treated as transparent when cropping and polygonizing.
controlHelp.colorMargin: Adds a 2px color margin around the sprite in the atlas to avoid scaling artifacts on small sprites.
controlHelp.minimalDistance: Controls polygon simplification. Higher values remove more nearby points.
controlHelp.pointCount: Limits the maximum number of points generated for each polygon.
controlHelp.slice9: Adds Slice 9 configuration so the sprite can be used as a nine-slice image.
controlHelp.sliceBottom: Sets the bottom fixed border of the Slice 9 sprite.
controlHelp.sliceLeft: Sets the left fixed border of the Slice 9 sprite.
controlHelp.sliceRight: Sets the right fixed border of the Slice 9 sprite.
controlHelp.sliceTop: Sets the top fixed border of the Slice 9 sprite.
controlHelp.transparentPadding: Adds 1px transparent padding to the sprite to avoid aliasing while it is rotated.
controlHelp.usePolygonsInsteadOfQuads: Converts the quad to polygons to make the sprite easier for the GPU to render and allow more sprites to fit in an atlas.
